# weekly-ceo-brief

**Trigger:** Prepare an evidence-based CEO report when a weekly review is due.

**Role:** Chief of Staff → Operations

**Required inputs:** Reporting period, repositories, outstanding issues, decisions

**Tools:** GitHub issues, PRs, commits, documentation when available and authorized.

**Procedure:** Verify completion, blockers, next tasks, risks and founder decisions; cite records and report unknown status without inventing progress.

**Output:** Four-part CEO brief in Bosnian.

**Success criterion:** Every status has evidence or clear uncertainty.

**Mandatory:** Evidence, priority, next action, dependencies and definition of done. Never expose secrets. A skill does not execute independently. Any merge, deployment, production IAM or Firebase rule change, client communication or spending requires explicit additional founder approval.
